podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Why AI Agents Don’t Carry Credit Cards & Tokenizing Real-World Finance with Bhau Kotecha
podcasts.description: Stablecoins have officially outgrown their origins as speculative crypto trading chips. Today, they represent the fastest-growing modern settlement rail, reshaping corporate treasuries, cross-border commerce, and real-world asset distribution. But while financial institutions and fintechs want onchain product velocity…, navigating regulatory compliance, liquidity architecture, and blockchain infrastructure remains a formidable barrier. That is where Paxos Labs comes in. Spun out of Paxos, the platform allows global fintechs and exchanges to launch turnkey stablecoins and tokenized assets on regulated rails without reinventing the infrastructure stack. With milestones like moving over $80 million dollars across Robinhood Chain and tokenizing physical commodities like gold onchain, they are pioneering what programmable money looks like in production. In this episode, we sit down with Bhau, to unpack the next phase of tokenized finance. We’ll explore how digital dollars are infiltrating enterprise treasuries, why autonomous AI agents urgently demand programmable rails, and how tokenized real-world assets are turning static balance sheets into liquid capital.
